name: Fall Guys
short_description: Jellybean characters stumble through obstacle-course game shows.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Jellybean characters stumble through obstacle-course game shows.

identity.core_loop: Run, jump, grab, survive rounds, crown.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Wobbly and silly; failing is funny.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Big readable obstacles; elimination is overlay.

rendering.signature: Candy colours with soft wrap light, glossy highlights and big rim light.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Soft rim light plus candy colours is the look kids already love.

tricks: Keyed run, jump and dive blended with a physics body, so bumps make the beans wobble and tumble
Getting knocked over is the comedy: the body goes floppy, then gets back up
motion.lesson: Mix keyed intent with a physics body; falling over should be funny and quick to recover from.
motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Make failure funny and physical, and kids keep playing.

review: Falling over is the joke, which is why kids love it. The world is the instructions. A strong reference for Ranch party games.
